limits: Structural read-only census; differing blobs are not semantic failures or resolved merge conflicts.
Identical files and mutually absent paths are reported separately.
No source edit, merge, ref or runtime action; no runtime qualification transfer.
No conclusion here authorizes any deletion or chooses an architectural replacement. Incoming audio/ASR/Studio behavior review is a separate next task.

test_module_files_under_tests.pattern: carr-library/tests/**/test_*.py; file counts, not test-case populations

classification_notes.already_current: Identical incoming/current Git blobs, or null/null for a deletion already made by both. The 214/156 split is recorded separately.
classification_notes.incoming_addition_absent_current: Added since old canonical; absent in our current tree.
classification_notes.incoming_modification_current_unmodified: Incoming changed an old path that our current tree retains byte-exact from e5.
classification_notes.incoming_deletion_current_unmodified: Incoming deleted a path that our current tree retains byte-exact from e5.
classification_notes.same_path_added_differently: Both sides added the same path since e5 with different Git blobs.
classification_notes.both_modified_differently: Both sides changed an old path with different Git blobs.
classification_notes.incoming_deletion_our_changed: Incoming deleted an old path that our tree changed.
classification_notes.ours_deleted_incoming_modification: Our tree deleted an old path that incoming modified.
classification_notes.structural_both_sides_diverged: 218 different same-path additions + 118 different modifications + 21 incoming deletions of our changed paths + 1 incoming modification of our deleted path. These 358 are structural overlap candidates, not a measured Git merge-conflict count.

ancestry.interpretation: Incoming contains old e5 canonical and owner078 ancestry, but is not a descendant of our R6/R7/f77/87d1 heads. Identical current files and shared deletions establish selected byte-level overlap only; no whole-predecessor or semantic-equivalence inference.

incoming_commit_metadata.message: docs: state the exact uninstall diagnostic regression coverage
incoming_commit_metadata.date_limit: Commit date is not the observed branch-movement time.

version_and_gate_caveats.interpretation: Incoming has a different workflow/qualification graph and source version. Existing historical reader metadata alone cannot admit it. Reconciliation must preserve or explicitly review changed source/version/oracle bindings; no frozen artifact reader is rebound here.

method.inputs: Complete recursive Git trees with truncated=false; all leaf entries are ordinary Git blobs. No gitlinks or mode-only differences.
method.path_selection: Sorted union of old and incoming blob paths, retaining exactly the paths whose Git blob identities differ; missing files are null.
method.current_comparison: Every retained incoming-delta row additionally records the exact current 87d1 Git blob or null. The complete incoming/current path union is separately listed.
method.hash_encoding: changed_path_set_sha256 uses compact JSON of the lexically sorted path array; delta_rows_canonical_sha256 uses compact JSON with recursively sorted object keys and preserved array order.
method.blob_scope: This census compares immutable Git blob identities; it does not independently read or SHA256-hash every product body.
method.preservation: Two newly added evidence documents only; all 1,833 baseline 87d1 files remain unchanged. No ref, merge, workflow or CI action.
